mapper.select: select rl.id, rl.review_id, rl.reader_id, rl.created_at, rl.updated_at, rl.deleted, u.username as reader_username from review_likes rl join users u on rl.reader_id = u.id where rl.review_id = #{reviewId} and rl.reader_id = #{readerId} and rl.deleted = false
select count(*) from review_likes where review_id = #{reviewId} and deleted = false
mapper.insert: insert into review_likes(review_id, reader_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted) values(#{review.id}, #{reader.id}, now(), now(), false) on duplicate key update updated_at = now(), deleted = false
mapper.update: update review_likes set deleted = true, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
